race.comment: THE SHYSTER (3) has been so good at both his runs. He has led both times and put big margins on rivals. Well backed in those efforts, he is bred to be quick and shows it. Easy to be sticking with him until he fails, especially from a low draw. FROSTED IN TIME (2) has been so consistent to date. He draws beside a main danger and has speed so will never be too far away. Goes well for his rider too. PAPARAZZO (1) came from last to score at Cootamundra. He will gain some confidence from that. Just the tough draw makes it difficult. SIR BASIL (8) went for a break in fine form. He has shown a real liking for wet ground so note the conditions.
